script:
old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_status = old_doc.status if old_doc else None
new_status = doc.status

if old_doc is None and new_status == "C0":
    frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "CRM Task",
        "task_type": "call_lead",
        "title": f"Call Lead — {doc.lead_name or doc.name}",
        "status": "Todo",
        "priority": "Medium",
        "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
        "reference_docname": doc.name,
        "description": f"New lead {doc.lead_name or doc.name} has arrived at C0. Make the initial call and log the disposition.",
    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

if old_status and old_status != new_status:
    if old_status in ("C0", "Cold", "Reactivated") and new_status not in ("C0", "Cold", "Reactivated"):
        frappe.enqueue(
            "crm.api.call_log.cancel_retry_log",
            lead_name=doc.name,
            permanent=True,
        )

    if new_status == "C1" and doc.email:
        frappe.enqueue(
            "crm.integrations.brevo.api.enroll_in_sequence",
            email=doc.email,
            lead_name=doc.name,
        )

    if new_status == "C2-Q":
        if not frappe.db.exists("CRM Quote Request", {"lead": doc.name, "status": "Pending"}):
            qr = frappe.new_doc("CRM Quote Request")
            qr.update({"lead": doc.name, "status": "Pending"})
            qr.append("activity_log", {
                "event_type": "Created",
                "state_to": "Pending",
                "by_user": frappe.session.user,
                "at_time": frappe.utils.now_datetime(),
                "note": f"Quote Request initiated for lead {doc.lead_name or doc.name}.",
            })
            qr.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        if not frappe.db.exists("CRM Task", {
            "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
            "reference_docname": doc.name,
            "task_type": "upload_quote",
            "status": ["in", ["Todo", "In Progress"]],
        }):
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "CRM Task",
                "task_type": "upload_quote",
                "title": f"Upload Quote — {doc.lead_name or doc.name}",
                "status": "Todo",
                "priority": "High",
                "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
                "reference_docname": doc.name,
                "description": f"Upload the quotation for lead {doc.lead_name}. Click the Upload Quote button on the task to open the Quote Request, attach the quote file, enter Quote Value and Margin, then set status to Quote Received.",
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if new_status == "C7":
        if not frappe.db.exists("CRM Task", {
            "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
            "reference_docname": doc.name,
            "task_type": "handle_fabricator_lead",
            "status": ["in", ["Todo", "In Progress"]],
        }):
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "CRM Task",
                "task_type": "handle_fabricator_lead",
                "title": f"Handle Fabricator Lead — {doc.lead_name or doc.name}",
                "status": "Todo",
                "priority": "High",
                "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
                "reference_docname": doc.name,
                "description": f"Lead {doc.lead_name} has been routed to B2F (C7). Review the fabricator routing reason, coordinate with the partner fabricator, and update the lead to Won (C8) or Lost (C6).",
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

if old_status == "Cold" and new_status and new_status != "Cold" and not doc.custom_reactivated_at:
    frappe.db.set_value("CRM Lead", doc.name, "custom_reactivated_at", frappe.utils.now_datetime())

script:
old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_assignee = old_doc.assigned_to if old_doc else None
new_assignee = doc.assigned_to

if doc.task_type == "upload_quote" and not old_assignee and new_assignee and doc.reference_doctype == "CRM Lead":
    qr_name = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Quote Request",
        {"lead": doc.reference_docname, "status": ["in", ["Pending", "Revision Requested"]]},
        "name",
        order_by="creation desc",
    )
    if qr_name:
        qr = frappe.get_doc("CRM Quote Request", qr_name)
        qr.append("activity_log", {
            "event_type": "Pool Task Claimed",
            "by_user": new_assignee,
            "at_time": frappe.utils.now_datetime(),
            "note": "Upload Quote task claimed.",
        })
        qr.save(ignore_permissions=True)
